payload.claim: The Context's "Other work on these files" paragraph is stale: it names SA-0338, SA-0339 as queued and #1042 (SA-0350)/#1043 (SA-0352) as open, but at this snapshot all four have already merged and been retired to .saffron/specs/done/. It also omits SA-0353, which is currently queued and whose own `touches` list names saffron/cli.py and tests/test_cli.py — the exact files this spec touches — and which edits the same `write` closure inside `_stack_follow_ups` that this spec must also edit. A person scheduling this spec against SA-0353 is not warned of this real overlap, while being warned about risks that no longer exist.
